Assistant (0.2s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Ms Hoffmann?

User (1.1s): Yes, this is Lena Hoffmann.

Assistant (1.8s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (3.2s): Thirty January nineteen eighty four.

Assistant (5.7s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (7.9s): Two two one nine.

Assistant (11.2s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. your car loan has a past-due amount of 1250.00, which is 14 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (12.6s): No, my salary arrives on six November and I can pay then. Am I talking to a robot?

Assistant (14.8s): I am Freya Bank's digital assistant. I have noted your request for 6 November. However, the latest date I can record for the car loan is Friday 23 October 2026; can you pay 1250.00 on that day?

User (17.6s): Yes, I can pay on twenty-third October twenty twenty-six.

Assistant (22.6s): To confirm: you will pay 1250.00 for the car loan on Friday 23 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (23.6s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (42.7s): Thank you. Your promise of 1250.00 for the car loan on Friday 23 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
